entries.title: Wikipedia — The Free Encyclopedia (English)
entries.summary: Multilingual free online encyclopedia covering history, science, biographies, geography, technology, culture, mathematics, and current events.

entries.title: Wikipédia — A enciclopédia livre (Português)
entries.summary: Enciclopédia livre em português com artigos sobre ciência, história, biografias, geografia, literatura, tecnologia e atualidades.

entries.title: Wikidata — Free Knowledge Base
entries.summary: Structured linked open data repository of entities, identifiers, dates, populations, organizations, and cross-language facts.

entries.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica
entries.summary: Fact-checked general reference encyclopedia covering history, biographies, philosophy, science, arts, and world geography.

entries.title: arXiv.org e-Print Archive
entries.summary: Open-access scientific preprint archive for physics, mathematics, computer science, AI, machine learning, quantitative biology, finance, and statistics.

entries.title: Semantic Scholar
entries.summary: Academic research paper discovery engine with citations, abstracts, authors, and open-access PDFs across computer science, biomedicine, and engineering.

entries.title: PubMed — Biomedical Literature (NCBI)
entries.summary: National Library of Medicine database of peer-reviewed biomedical, clinical medicine, genetics, pharmacology, and life sciences literature.

entries.title: OpenAlex — Open Catalog of Scholarly Works
entries.summary: Open bibliographic catalog indexing scholarly papers, journals, institutions, authors, DOIs, and citation graphs worldwide.

entries.title: Crossref — Scholarly DOI Metadata
entries.summary: Official DOI registration agency for academic journals, conference proceedings, books, and bibliographic citation metadata.

entries.title: Nature — International Journal of Science
entries.summary: Leading peer-reviewed scientific journal and science news covering biology, physics, climate, astronomy, AI, and medicine.

entries.title: Science (AAAS)
entries.summary: Peer-reviewed multidisciplinary scientific research and science policy news published by the American Association for the Advancement of Science.

entries.title: SciELO — Scientific Electronic Library Online
entries.summary: Open-access scientific journal network for Brazil, Latin America, Portugal, and Ibero-America covering peer-reviewed research articles.

entries.title: DOAJ — Directory of Open Access Journals
entries.summary: Community-curated directory indexing peer-reviewed open-access scholarly journals and articles across all disciplines.

entries.title: CTAN — Comprehensive TeX Archive Network
entries.summary: Official repository of LaTeX and TeX packages, classes, BibLaTeX styles, Beamer themes, TikZ libraries, and package documentation.

entries.title: Overleaf LaTeX Documentation & Guides
entries.summary: Practical guides and syntax reference for LaTeX equations, tables, figures, bibliographies, TikZ diagrams, Beamer slides, and document classes.

entries.title: TeX — LaTeX Stack Exchange
entries.summary: Question-and-answer community for LaTeX, TeX, XeLaTeX, LuaLaTeX, Tectonic, BibTeX, TikZ, and typesetting troubleshooting.

entries.title: BBC News — World & Breaking News
entries.summary: International breaking news, world politics, economy, science, climate, technology, and global headlines from the BBC.

entries.title: Reuters — Breaking International News & Markets
entries.summary: Global wire-service news covering world affairs, financial markets, business, technology, energy, and geopolitics.

entries.title: Associated Press (AP News)
entries.summary: Independent global news agency providing factual reporting on international events, politics, science, health, and sports.

entries.title: The Guardian — International News
entries.summary: World news, analysis, climate reporting, technology, culture, and international journalism.

entries.title: Al Jazeera — Breaking News & World Coverage
entries.summary: International news coverage focusing on the Middle East, Africa, Asia, Europe, Americas, and global affairs.

entries.title: Deutsche Welle (DW) — World News
entries.summary: German international broadcaster covering European and global news, politics, economy, science, and environment.

entries.title: NPR News
entries.summary: Public radio news reporting on US and world events, science, health, economy, and culture.

entries.title: UN News — Global Perspective Human Stories
entries.summary: Official United Nations news on diplomacy, humanitarian crises, climate summits, human rights, and sustainable development.

entries.title: G1 — Notícias do Brasil e do Mundo
entries.summary: Portal de notícias brasileiro com cobertura em tempo real de Brasil, mundo, economia, política, ciência, saúde e tecnologia.

entries.title: Agência Brasil (EBC)
entries.summary: Agência pública nacional de notícias do Brasil cobrindo políticas públicas, economia, educação, ciência, justiça e cidadania.

entries.title: BBC News Brasil
entries.summary: Notícias internacionais, Brasil, ciência, saúde, economia e tecnologia em português pela BBC.

entries.title: Hacker News
entries.summary: Technology and startup news aggregator covering software engineering, AI, open-source releases, security, and research.

entries.title: GitHub — Open Source Repositories & Releases
entries.summary: Source code hosting platform for open-source projects, release notes, issue trackers, changelogs, and software documentation.

entries.title: Python 3 Official Documentation
entries.summary: Authoritative Python 3 language reference, standard library modules, tutorials, PEPs, and release notes.

entries.title: PyPI — The Python Package Index
entries.summary: Official repository of Python packages, versions, dependencies, release histories, and installation instructions.

entries.title: MDN Web Docs
entries.summary: Comprehensive documentation for HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web APIs, HTTP headers, browsers, and web standards.

entries.title: npm — JavaScript Package Registry
entries.summary: Registry of JavaScript and TypeScript packages, Node.js libraries, React/Vite tools, and version compatibility metadata.

entries.title: Stack Overflow
entries.summary: Developer Q&A knowledge base covering programming languages, debugging, algorithms, databases, and frameworks.

entries.title: Hugging Face — Models, Datasets & Spaces
entries.summary: Open AI hub hosting machine learning models, LLMs, benchmarks, model cards, datasets, and transformers documentation.

entries.title: RFC Editor (IETF Internet Standards)
entries.summary: Official archive of IETF RFC specifications for HTTP, OAuth 2.0, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP, JSON, and internet protocols.

entries.title: W3C Web Standards
entries.summary: World Wide Web Consortium technical specifications for HTML, CSS, SVG, MathML, WCAG accessibility, and web architecture.

entries.title: Our World in Data
entries.summary: Research and empirical global statistics on population, energy, climate change, health, poverty, education, and technology.

entries.title: World Bank Open Data
entries.summary: International macroeconomic indicators, GDP, inflation, demographics, development statistics, and country datasets.

entries.title: World Health Organization (WHO) — News & Fact Sheets
entries.summary: Global public health updates, disease outbreaks, medical guidelines, epidemiology, and international health statistics.

entries.title: NASA — Space Exploration & Science News
entries.summary: Space missions, astronomy, planetary science, Earth observation, Artemis, James Webb Space Telescope, and aeronautics updates.

entries.title: IBGE — Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística
entries.summary: Dados oficiais do Brasil sobre censo demográfico, IPCA (inflação), PIB, desemprego, geografia e estatísticas socioeconômicas.
